entry.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
entry.summary:
Researchers extracted hidden, encrypted reasoning traces from proprietary LLMs by replaying encrypted context blocks into weaker model variants to jailbreak them into outputting the raw thinking text.

Why it matters: This research reveals that encrypted API context mechanisms can create cross-model side channels, exposing sensitive chain-of-thought reasoning and enabling high-consequence prompt injections.

entry.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
entry.summary:
Researchers extracted proprietary LLM reasoning traces by replaying encrypted chain-of-thought API blocks into weaker sibling models and jailbreaking them to output the raw plaintext.

Why it matters: The attack exposes proprietary chain-of-thought reasoning logic and reveals a critical vector where models inherently trust hidden reasoning blocks, enabling high-severity prompt injection.

entry.title: There are no lossless transformations of natural-language text
entry.summary:
Sophie Alpert's acceptable use policy for AI writing highlights that natural-language text transformations are inherently lossy because rephrasing without the author's precise mental representation alters the original meaning.

Why it matters: Relying on LLMs to rephrase text risks changing the intended meaning and confusing readers unless authors rigorously review the output to ensure it accurately reflects their thoughts.

entry.title: An opinionated guide to which AI to use to do stuff
entry.summary:
Ethan Mollick's AI guide now emphasizes agentic systems capable of extensive human-equivalent work, with a focus on AI access to user computers via modes like ChatGPT Work/Codex and Claude Cowork/Code, while Gemini has fallen off his list.

Why it matters: The evolution towards agentic AI systems with direct computer access significantly expands AI capabilities for complex tasks, but inconsistent naming conventions create user confusion.

entry.title: Expanding our partnership with Cognizant | Anthropic
entry.summary:
Anthropic and Cognizant expanded their partnership, with Cognizant embedding Claude across its platforms, training over 30,000 associates, and becoming a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network.

Why it matters: This partnership aims to bridge the gap between rising AI capability and enterprise absorption by integrating Claude into existing industry-specific systems and workflows.

entry.title: sqlite-utils 3.39.1
entry.summary:
sqlite-utils version 3.39.1 has been released, back-porting a specific bug fix from version 4.

Why it matters: Users running sqlite-utils version 3 receive a back-ported fix for table.delete_where() without needing to upgrade to version 4.

entry.title: Building abundant intelligence
entry.summary:
OpenAI is pursuing a full-stack approach to develop advanced AI that is more capable, affordable, and broadly useful.

Why it matters: This initiative aims to democratize access to advanced AI by making it more powerful, economical, and applicable across various domains.

entry.title: Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest (and inspired mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp)
entry.summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) 2.0, or 2026-07-28 specification, introduces a stateless design, simplifying client/server implementations and enhancing scalability for LLM agent frameworks.

Why it matters: The simplified stateless design makes MCP tools easier to audit and control, enabling smaller models to drive them effectively and reducing implementation complexity for developers.

entry.title: llm-mcp-client 0.1a0
entry.summary:
llm-mcp-client 0.1a0 has been released, introducing a new client for the model-context-protocol.

Why it matters: This release provides a new client implementation for interacting with the model-context-protocol, potentially enabling new integrations or functionalities.

entry.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
entry.summary:
OpenAI announces lower GPT-5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra, enabling more efficient AI workflow deployment for enterprises.

Why it matters: Reduced pricing and increased efficiency for GPT-5.6 models facilitate broader enterprise adoption of AI workflows.
